name: Buffalo Sauce
siboNotes: Buffalo sauce is typically FODMAP-free and well-tolerated, but spicy foods may trigger symptoms in some sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for added garlic or onion powder which would make it high FODMAP
Look for simple recipes with just hot sauce, butter, and vinegar
Start with smaller amounts if sensitive to spicy foods
Homemade versions allow better ingredient control
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of vitamin A from cayenne peppers
Low sodium compared to many condiments
